tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: aged newsprint. Default background for every layout.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Inset panels, story sidebars and tinted relief blocks. ink and ink-muted both read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headlines on paper and paper-deep (13:1+); text on ray-yellow (7.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, bylines, issue dates, on paper (6.7:1) and paper-deep (5.5:1).

tokens.name: rocket-red
tokens.usage: The brand hue: mastheads, primary buttons, the one loud headline per spread. As text on paper (4.7:1); paper text on it (4.7:1).

tokens.name: atomic-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: links, secondary actions, switch on-states, the focus ring (2px solid; 4.7:1 on paper, 3.9:1 on paper-deep). Paper text on it (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ray-yellow
tokens.usage: Signal fills only: price bursts, 'NEW!' flags, highlight bars. Always ink text on it; never yellow text on paper.

tokens.name: night-sky
tokens.usage: Deep fields: cover panels, footers, starfield bands. Paper text on it (11:1).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Rules, borders, control outlines and ornament on paper (4.0:1, meets 3:1 for marks). Not for body text.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: Issue title and cover names, set uppercase in rocket-red or ink. One per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Story and section titles, uppercase, ink on paper.

styles.name: deck
styles.sample: A breathless account of the century to come, as told by the man who went there.
styles.usage: Standfirst under a headline; ink-muted or ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The convector hummed, and the laboratory filled with a light the colour of old brass.
styles.usage: Running text, ink on paper, measure 60–72 characters.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, bylines and footnotes in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers, issue lines, buttons and tags.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a kicker and its headline; icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Button and tag padding; gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Column gutters and panel padding; the base layout grid.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page margins and separation between story blocks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for panels, cards and images: printed matter has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and ticket stubs: a press-cut softening, nothing rounder.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Portholes, rivets, planets, switch tracks and badges only; never on rectangles of text.

shadow.note: Printed matter has no soft shadows. The one shadow is a hard ink offset, like a slightly mis-registered second plate.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Buttons and story cards on paper. Buttons drop it while pressed. Never on night-sky panels.
